label: Ubiquiti UniFi Mobile Router (UMR)
description: UniFi Mobile Router: 2x 1G RJ45, LTE Cat 4 (150/50 Mbps), WiFi 4, PoE+ input with 10 W PoE passthrough, DIN/wall mount.
notes: Vendor figures: **(2) GbE RJ45 ports**, **LTE Cat 4** (150 Mbps down / 50 Mbps up), WiFi 4 1x1, 9 W, PoE+ (48-54 V) or USB-C or 4-pin ATX DC. The PoE row is the interesting one: **(1) PoE input and (1) PoE output, max 10 W, which requires a PoE+ switch** - so it can be powered by the switch it sits on *and* pass power through to one downstream device, but only when the upstream is PoE+ rather than plain 802.3af.
